units.summary: New benchmark helper that opens a DB with auto-compaction disabled and fills the head with many series of in-order samples. It only runs in benchmarks, so a short skim is enough.
units.headline: Add benchmark DB setup helper for selected-series benchmarks
units.reason: New test-only helper used by benchmarks; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: New test helper that picks a count of refs spaced evenly across a slice. Used only by benchmarks.
units.headline: Add helper picking evenly spaced series refs for benchmarks
units.reason: New test-only helper with no production callers.

units.summary: New benchmark measuring CompactSelectedSeries across selected fractions of a 100k-series head, rebuilding the DB each iteration with the timer stopped. Test-only.
units.headline: Add benchmark for CompactSelectedSeries at varying selection fractions
units.reason: New benchmark only; no production behavior change.

units.summary: Adds a new public DB method that writes a caller-provided set of head series into blocks and evicts them from the head, skipping series with OOO data. It sorts and dedups refs, reuses compactHeadViewLocked, and records new metrics. It holds cmtx and deletes head data, so persistence and concurrency behavior matter.
units.headline: Add CompactSelectedSeries to persist and evict chosen head series
units.reason: New public API that persists blocks and evicts series from the head under the compaction lock; data-loss-sensitive.
focus: Eviction watermark logic: series receiving samples after the ref list was taken are retained
Skipping of series with OOO data so OOO chunks are not orphaned
Failure path: blocks written but eviction or reload errors leave consistent state
Metrics increments on early-return and error paths

units.summary: New test covering a head whose min and max time are equal, checking the series is evicted and one block is produced.
units.headline: Test eviction when head holds a single timestamp
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: New test checking nil or empty refs is a no-op: no blocks and the triggered counter stays zero.
units.headline: Test CompactSelectedSeries is a no-op for empty refs
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior.
